description: Mechanical cross-check of contraction_block_cut_tree.md Parts I-V: attachment-core pruning (connectivity, all-leaves-marked, attachment representation, path projection without repetition), the attachment-free-leaf S5 consequence, the singly-marked-leaf MA1 construction, and the MA2 trichotomy.
scope_note: Does not re-derive S5 or the Gao-Huo-Liu-Ma admissible-path theorem (both cited by name from lemmas.md/two_cut.md). The MA1 construction check uses explicitly hand-picked x-z paths (not derived from the cited theorem) purely to exercise the mechanical concatenation-with-S construction and confirm it preserves the length difference; it does not independently verify the theorem's own {1,2} guarantee. Kept separate from the eight prior contraction verifiers, none of which are touched.
note_on_python_version: Same environment note as prior manifests: requirements.txt/.python-version pin CPython 3.14.6, unavailable in this container; this run used 3.13.12 with networkx==3.6.1 (matches requirements.txt's pin exactly).
detector_agreement: Block-cut tree structure computed via networkx.biconnected_components/articulation_points (an independent library routine, not this project's own code), pruning and projection logic verified by direct construction/inspection. 0 disagreements.
completed_range: All gadgets processed to completion; this is a small, deterministic set of explicit illustrative constructions, not a search or census -- consistent with the phase's explicit decision not to launch broad computation.
